fields.label: Verdict
fields.value: U-9175 RESOLVED and closed as a red herring. D2 does NOT close — the recovery gap is an X/Z-plane problem, not the Y channel.

fields.label: U-9175
fields.value: +0xb18 (drive-force Y) is a STRUCTURAL zero on the original (forward-Y +0x9d8 is bit-exact 0.0 on every frame, live-tested) and a physically-negligible float-epsilon on the port (~3.05e-08).

fields.label: Root
fields.value: The port's omega.x/z (+0x9bc/+0x9c4) carry ~5e-10 FP noise from the contact torque sum, which BodyOrientationIntegrate drifts into the matrix at-row Y. The original's omega.x/z are exactly 0 on flat ground.

fields.label: Why no fix
fields.value: Diffuse FP noise, no single faithfully-portable producer. Forcing at.y=0 is a forbidden clamp. Velocity-Y effect ~5e-7/frame — cannot be the ~10x recovery deficit. STEP 2 not entered per PREREG.

fields.label: Live test
fields.value: --axis-probe (A6a-PRE + A6b-POST entry hooks, ESI-filtered), self-check DAT_00614708==[0,0,1], 2179 frames, err=null, PREREG committed before any run.
